La stretta collaborazione nel team interprofessionale è centrale per noi – consente cure e terapie olistiche e orientate alle necessità. In 285 posti letto, la clinica fornisce assistenza paziente in modo stazionario. La clinica è specializzata in riabilitazione geriatrica, interna, cardiovascolare e polmonare, medicina psicosomatica e psicoterapia, psicocardiologia e medicina del sonno. Un'operazione vivace con il lavoro interprofessionale vi aspetta, che recupera tutte le competenze di un infermieristico o di una persona infermieristica. Il Barmelweid ha oltre 750 dipendenti. Nursing specialist in psychosomatic medicine and psychotherapy (a) for the private ward. Is working in an interprofessional team important to you? Then you've come to the right place. Level of employment: 60–100% Entry immediately or by arrangement More holidays on request, public transport contribution, Reka checks, snow sports day or on a first-name basis with the boss? Barmelweid offers you these and other advantages. More information here Get to know us This is how we tick On our mixed psychotherapeutic and psychosomatic ward we look after 12 patients in a milieu therapeutic setting. Close collaboration within the interprofessional team is central to us – it enables holistic, needs-oriented care and therapy. Here you contribute your specialist knowledge and actively shape your environment. This is what you do with us You look after and accompany 12 patients in their everyday life in our private ward Active participation in shaping the milieu therapeutic structures in the department is part of your area of ​​responsibility You work according to the lean philosophy and interprofessionally for our patients You ensure the care process and organize the daily routine You support and encourage our patients as part of the caregiver work You inspire us... with your completed training as a qualified nursing specialist. Nursing specialist HF with your self-organized way of working as well as independence with your strong social skills and communication skills and your willingness to work in shifts (3 shifts) About us Barmelweid is the leading specialist and rehabilitation clinic in northwestern Switzerland and the largest psychosomatic clinic in Switzerland. The clinic cares for inpatients in 285 beds. The clinic specializes in geriatric, internal medicine, cardiovascular and pulmonary rehabilitation, long Covid, psychosomatic medicine and psychotherapy, psychocardiology and sleep medicine. At Barmelweid, the focus is on lean thinking and methods: all efforts are aimed at the patients. This includes standardized safety rounds, the patient board and leveling the utilization of the wards using flows. Care in the Department of Psychosomatic Medicine and Psychotherapy is completed using the reference care method, while care in the Department of Internal Medicine is completed using care managers. As a rule, patients stay at Barmelweid for 2 to 6 weeks. This gives our nurses time to engage with the patients in greater depth. You can expect a lively company with interprofessional work that uses all the skills of a carer. Barmelweid employs over 750 people. It is located at around 800 meters above sea level in a clearing in the Aargau Jura and is embedded in a unique environment with a nature park.
